name: HDFS 3192
title: Early Childhood Development and Education: Supervised Fieldwork Practicum
description: Supervised participation at Child Development Lab and/or approved early childhood program. Focus on observational assessment and intentional interactions with young children to develop relationships and guide learning/development through play. Formerly offered as HDFS 3183.
requirement_description: HDFS 2120, HDFS 2192, HDFS 3101, HDFS 3102; HDFS 3122 or HDFS 3123, which may be concurrent; open to juniors or higher.
